assignment.title: UI quality loop
assignment.task: Complete the supplied task by executing the workflow graph and preserving its decision history.

workflow.name: UI quality loop
workflow.description: Implement, review in parallel, loop on quality failures, and prepare a handoff.

data.label: Implement UI
data.description: Build the new product grid from the approved brief.
data.instruction:
You are the implementation agent for **{{project.name}}**.

Read `{{project.instructions}}` and the supplied brief before changing code. Implement the smallest complete solution that matches the existing architecture and design language.

## Guardrails

- Preserve unrelated changes.
- Prefer existing primitives and tokens.
- Run `{{commands.check}}` before returning.
- Return changed files, decisions, and known limitations.

## Task

{{task}}

data.label: Code review
data.description: Check correctness, maintainability, and project conventions.
data.instruction:
Review the current patch against the task and the conventions in `{{project.instructions}}`.

Prioritize findings that can cause incorrect behavior, regressions, security issues, data loss, or broken tests. Include file and line references. Do not block on style preferences already enforced by tooling.

Return:

1. `verdict`: `pass` or `revise`
2. `findings`: ordered by severity
3. `summary`: one concise paragraph

data.label: Visual judge
data.description: Compare desktop and mobile renders to the reference.
data.instruction:
Inspect the rendered result at `{{preview.url}}` in the configured viewports.

Evaluate hierarchy, spacing, typography, alignment, contrast, responsive behavior, and fidelity to the reference. Separate objective mismatches from aesthetic suggestions.

Pass when there are no blocking mismatches. Otherwise return `revise` with measurable corrections and attach an annotated screenshot when possible.

Tolerance: `{{visual.tolerance}}`

data.label: Quality gate
data.description: Merge reviewer verdicts and choose the next route.
data.instruction:
Read every upstream verdict.

- Route to `ship` only when all required verdicts are `pass`.
- Route to `revise` when any required verdict is `revise`.
- Route to `blocked` when a required verdict is missing or malformed.

Return only the selected route and a one-sentence reason.

data.label: Ship summary
data.instruction:
Create a concise final handoff for **{{project.name}}**.

Include what changed, why, verification performed, and any remaining risks. Prefer concrete evidence over process narration. Format the result so it can be pasted into a pull request description.
